layers.name: Lightning animation
layers.description: The lightning is XOR-drawn directly into the multicolor bitmap from 56 stored frames. The drawing races the raster beam, so some frames show the old and the new bolt split across rows; the sequence plays exactly as the demo shows it.

layers.name: Ring of fire (sprites)
layers.description: Eight multicolor sprites sweep two arcs of flame around the rim in 11 steps of three frames, one burst every 158 frames; the middle burst of every three runs backwards.
